| Aequo Legal | Yes | Wills and estate planning offered; confirm pricing | Ask the firm |

| Armstrong Kutz Lawyers | 15 min | Yes | Ask the firm |


*Fees and consultation conditions are based on the firms' published information available during this search. Confirm current prices, eligibility and exactly what is included before engaging a solicitor.*

## My recommendation

- **For family law with financial flexibility\:** start with Rosen Lawyers, R&G Law Group or The Law People.
- **For a straightforward will on a budget\:** compare Generations Law with R&G Law Group and Jindalee Lawyers.
- **For both family law and estate planning\:** contact R&G Law Group, Aequo Legal or Jindalee Lawyers first.

One important distinction: a free initial consultation usually provides preliminary advice, not a full review of your case. A deferred-fee arrangement also does not necessarily mean fees are waived; ask when payment becomes due, whether interest or funding charges apply, and whether you remain liable if your matter is unsuccessful.

If you tell me whether your priority is **\(a) separation/property settlement, (b) wills and estate planning, or (c) a deceased-estate dispute**, I can narrow this to the three most suitable firms and compare their published fees and payment conditions.

## My recommendation

- **For family law with financial flexibility\:** start with Rosen Lawyers, R&G Law Group or The Law People.
- **For a straightforward will on a budget\:** compare Generations Law with R&G Law Group and Jindalee Lawyers.
- **For both family law and estate planning\:** contact R&G Law Group, Aequo Legal or Jindalee Lawyers first.

One important distinction: a free initial consultation usually provides preliminary advice, not a full review of your case. A deferred-fee arrangement also does not necessarily mean fees are waived; ask when payment becomes due, whether interest or funding charges apply, and whether you remain liable if your matter is unsuccessful.

If you tell me whether your priority is **\(a) separation/property settlement, (b) wills and estate planning, or (c) a deceased-estate dispute**, I can narrow this to the three most suitable firms and compare their published fees and payment conditions.
